# Generated by Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic)
Autoware DDS settings — what FISH needs on the host and in the container
=========================================================================
Written 2026-08-16. Source of truth:
  https://docs.autoware.org/main/installation/additional-settings-for-developers/network-configuration/dds-settings/
  (+ sibling page "Enable multicast for lo")

Why this file exists (the 2026-08-16 incident)
----------------------------------------------
Five Autoware logging_simulator sessions (fish_20260420_232806,
fish_20260629_115617, fish_20260816_155025, fish_20260816_155937 and the
first Aug-16 run) produced 0 CUDA kernels in pointcloud_container although
the bag replayed and the launch was "healthy". Two stacked causes, both
DDS configuration, neither a FISH bug:

  1. RMW fell back to rmw_fastrtps_cpp.
     The Autoware image exports RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp only in
     /root/.bashrc. Non-interactive shells (bash -lc, docker run … bash -c —
     i.e. every scripted run) do NOT source .bashrc, so ROS 2 used the Humble
     default FastRTPS. Under Autoware load (~495 DDS participants, 4 lidars)
     FastRTPS delivered ~6% of /clock and 0% of velodyne_packets/imu.
     Evidence: snapshot/ps_tree.txt → `ros2-daemon --rmw-implementation …`
       Apr19 cyclone 12.4K kernels | Apr27 cyclone 14.6K | Aug16-r3 cyclone 8.9K
       Apr20 fastrtps 8            | Jun29 fastrtps 0   | Aug16-r1/r2 fastrtps 0
     The April "it works one day, not the next" mystery = interactive
     (docker exec -it → .bashrc → Cyclone) vs scripted (bash -lc → FastRTPS).

  2. Cyclone without config + default kernel buffers drops the big frames.
     With RMW fixed (Aug16-r3/r4) left/right lidar reached ~99%, but the
     TOP lidar (~600 kB/frame) reached 53/288 (18%) and only 10 frames made
     it through the decoder to concatenate_data ("transformed_raw_points[top]
     is nullptr, skipping" ×281 in fishlog/launch_full.log). Cyclone's default
     MaxMessageSize (~14.7 kB) splits a 600 kB frame into ~40 datagrams;
     with net.core.rmem_max=212992 (208 KiB) and ipfrag_high_thresh=4 MiB /
     ipfrag_time=30 s the IP reassembly pool overflows and frames are lost.
     Evidence: snapshot/env.txt of fish_20260816_162248.

What Autoware requires (verbatim values from the doc)
----------------------------------------------------
HOST (kernel, once per boot; needs sudo — Claude cannot run sudo here):

    sudo sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=2147483647 \
                   net.ipv4.ipfrag_time=3 \
                   net.ipv4.ipfrag_high_thresh=134217728
    sudo ip link set lo multicast on

  Persistent sysctls (done on odachi 2026-08-16):

    printf 'net.core.rmem_max=2147483647\nnet.ipv4.ipfrag_time=3\nnet.ipv4.ipfrag_high_thresh=134217728\n' \
      | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/10-cyclone-max.conf

  `lo multicast on` is NOT persistent across reboots. Autoware's doc gives a
  systemd unit; until we add it, re-run the ip link command after each boot.
  (Note: /home/tue037807 rebooted 2026-08-16 12:03 → all of the above was at
  defaults again that afternoon.)

  Defaults for reference: rmem_max 212992, ipfrag_time 30, ipfrag_high_thresh
  4194304, lo without MULTICAST flag.

CONTAINER / SESSION (FISH handles these — see "How FISH enforces it"):

    export RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp
    export CYCLONEDDS_URI=file:///opt/ros/humble/fish/cyclonedds_autoware.xml

  cyclonedds_autoware.xml (repo: config/cyclonedds_autoware.xml, verbatim
  from the doc): lo-only NetworkInterface, AllowMulticast default,
  MaxMessageSize 65500B, ParticipantIndex none, SocketReceiveBufferSize
  min=10MB, WhcHigh 500kB.

  Doc warning kept as-is: do NOT put ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1 in ~/.bashrc
  (known issue); the lo-only Cyclone interface config is the supported way.

How FISH enforces / records it (all added 2026-08-16)
-----------------------------------------------------
config/fish_settings.ini [ros]
    rmw_implementation =      # e.g. rmw_cyclonedds_cpp
    cyclonedds_uri =          # e.g. cyclonedds_autoware.xml (resolved under /opt/ros/humble/fish/)
  Both empty by default (repo-wide ini is also copied into Isaac ROS images).
  Autoware run scripts set them via sed inside the fresh container.

scripts/install_fish.sh
  - copies config/*.xml → /opt/ros/humble/fish/
  - generated ros2 wrapper, on `ros2 launch/run` with FISH_ENABLED=1:
      RMW guard: env RMW_IMPLEMENTATION kept if set; else [ros] rmw_implementation
                 exported; else loud WARNING (FastRTPS default). Always prints
                 "[FISH] Effective RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=…".
      Cyclone guard: if RMW is cyclone and CYCLONEDDS_URI unset, export
                 [ros] cyclonedds_uri (file existence checked). Prints
                 "[FISH] Effective CYCLONEDDS_URI=…".

python/fish/snapshot.py (shutdown snapshot)
  - snapshot/env.txt: RMW_IMPLEMENTATION, CYCLONEDDS_URI, ROS_*, FISH_*,
    EFFECTIVE_RMW, the four sysctls above, lo_multicast=yes/no
  - snapshot/cyclonedds_effective.xml: copy of the XML in effect
  - fishlog/launch_full.log: full `ros2 launch` stdout/stderr (previously
    only /tmp/fish_launch_output.log inside the container, lost with --rm)

Checklist before an Autoware FISH run
-------------------------------------
  [ ] sysctl -n net.core.rmem_max               → 2147483647
  [ ] sysctl -n net.ipv4.ipfrag_time            → 3
  [ ] sysctl -n net.ipv4.ipfrag_high_thresh     → 134217728
  [ ] ip -o link show lo | grep MULTICAST       → present
  [ ] fresh container (never reuse), image never overwritten
  [ ] launch log shows "Effective RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_cyclonedds_cpp"
      and "Effective CYCLONEDDS_URI=<unset>"  (XML deliberately OFF — see
      bisection below; the doc's XML starves centerpoint in our setup)
  After the run, verify from data, not from feelings:
  [ ] snapshot/env.txt matches the four lines above
  [ ] fishlog/launch_full.log: no "transformed_raw_points[…top…] is nullptr" spam
  [ ] trace: /sensing/lidar/top/velodyne_packets sub callback_start ≈ 288 (bag count)
  [ ] nsys pointcloud_container sqlite has CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL rows

Bisection result (2026-08-16 evening) — READ THIS BEFORE ENABLING THE XML
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  run  session                sysctl+lo_mcast  XML   top velodyne  KERNEL  centerpoint            ndt/align
  r3   fish_20260816_161041   no               no    (n/a)         8858    ok
  r4   fish_20260816_162248   no               no    53/288 (18%)  7737    162 frames, 130 objs   quiet
  r5   fish_20260816_163832   YES              YES   220 (76%)     8       55 frames, ALL fail    22× "align server failed",
                                                                                                  22× "No InputSource"
  r6   fish_20260816_164759   YES              no    261 (91%)     3314    ~130-158 frames        quiet
  r7   fish_20260816_165836   YES              no    288 (100%)    14461   ~220 frames, 12 fail   quiet   ← bag rate 0.5x

  → host sysctls + `ip link set lo multicast on` alone fix the top-lidar
    loss (18% → 91%) and keep GPU inference alive.
  → the doc's cyclonedds_autoware.xml, in OUR setup (docker --net host,
    ~495 participants, all on one host), STARVES centerpoint (every frame
    "Fail to preprocess" = TF lookup failure) and breaks NDT/localization
    init. It kills some inter-process topic delivery — /tf_static or the
    localization pointcloud are the suspects; the culprit parameter
    is NOT bisected yet (needs 2-3 more 6-min runs).
    Trace evidence (per-subscriber callback counts, r4 → r5 → r6):
        /tf (38 subs)                                716 → 30  → 332
        /localization/kinematic_state                683 → 0   → 288
        /perception/obstacle_segmentation/pointcloud 128 → 0   → 208
        /tf_static (transient_local, 2 msgs)           2 → 2   → 2
        concatenated/pointcloud (rviz, inter-proc)   257 → 266 → 202
    i.e. the XML killed SMALL, HIGH-RATE, MANY-READER inter-process topics
    while big lidar frames still flowed. Leading hypothesis:
    <SocketReceiveBufferSize min="10MB"/> — with rmem_max now 2 GiB the
    kernel actually grants it: ~495 DDS participants × 10 MB ≈ 4.9 GB, above
    the host's net.ipv4.udp_mem pressure threshold (1001664 pages ≈ 3.8 GB;
    max 1502496 ≈ 5.7 GB). Above pressure the kernel drops datagrams for
    sockets over their fair share → /tf collapses → centerpoint TF lookups
    fail → "Fail to preprocess" → no inference. The doc assumes one Autoware
    per box; FISH adds nsys wrappers, collectors and ros2 daemons as extra
    participants. Next bisect step: same XML minus SocketReceiveBufferSize.
    snapshot/env.txt now records net.ipv4.udp_mem + /proc/net/sockstat UDP
    memory so this is directly visible next time.
  → DECISION: keep [ros] cyclonedds_uri EMPTY. Wrapper/ini/snapshot support
    stays in place; re-enable only after bisecting.
  → KERNEL count depends strongly on BAG RATE, not (only) on nsys timing:
    1.0x → 3314-8858 (decoder "Missed pointcloud output deadline", concat
    collector resets, dropped frames); 0.5x → 14461 (r7), matching Apr-27's
    14576 at 0.2x. At 1.0x this host cannot keep up with 4 lidars + FISH.
    → RECOMMENDED bag rate for Autoware measurement runs: 0.5x (or 0.2x for
    a fully clean chain). Treat the rate as a measurement parameter and
    record it (it is in fishlog/fish_events replay_start cmd).

Still open (not DDS)
--------------------
  - Localization never initialises: bag has no initial pose; ekf_localizer
    "Provide initial pose to pose_initializer", map↔base_link TF missing →
    planning/occupancy chain idle. GPU (centerpoint) is unaffected. Fix =
    publish /initialpose (or add to bag) if the paper needs the full chain.
  - launch_inspect.log: `model_name=pointpainting` invalid (Autoware 2026-04
    image only knows bevfusion_*) — config drift, harmless for centerpoint.
  - topic_hz.json holds only 2 topics in short sessions (known bug).
